logp.method_description: The octanol-water partition coefficient (log Pow) determination is a tool that measures the hydrophilicity/lipophilicity of a compound74-79 and was determined by UV-vis measurements and the shake-flask method.64 Here, deionized H2O and 1-octanol were used as the aqueous and organic phases, respectively. Solutions of 1-5 were prepared separately as aqueous phases (V = 20 mL), and the UV-vis spectra were recorded. From the above aqueous solution, a 3 mL aliquot was placed in a test tube and an equal volume of organic phase was added. The mixture was stirred vigorously for 2 h and then centrifuged for 15 min at 2000 rpm to segregate the phases. Later, the UV-vis spectrum of the aqueous phase was recorded. By using the following equation and the help of a standard method,64,80 the partition coefficient was calculated logP(o/w) = log10(Corg / Caq) where the molar concentrations of the complexes in the organic and aqueous phase are represented as Corg and Caq, respectively.
